args.sql:
CREATE VIEW container_depletion_rank_view AS
SELECT 
    containregistry,
    containmodel,
    volliters,
    masskg,
    containflag,
    coolkind,
    coolmass,
    coolremainpct,
    coolrefills,
    refilllatest,
    refillnext,
    (100 - coolremainpct) AS coolant_usage,
    CASE 
        WHEN (100 - coolremainpct) >= 75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN (100 - coolremainpct) >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS depletion_status
FROM 
    container;
